description: This Java source file defines the ResourceBundleMapWrapper class, which allows a ResourceBundle to be used as a Map with additional stack-based layering and expansion features. It includes nested class InternalRbmWrapper for internal resource bundle handling.

classes.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
classes.description: A Map wrapper around ResourceBundle with stack layering and string expansion capabilities.

classes.name: InternalRbmWrapper
classes.description: Internal class that wraps a ResourceBundle and provides Map interface for its keys and values.

methods.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the wrapper with various resource bundle configurations.

methods.name: addBottomResourceBundle
methods.description: Adds a resource bundle or internal wrapper to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: pushResourceBundle
methods.description: Pushes a resource bundle onto the top of the stack, overriding lower layers.

methods.name: getInitialResourceBundle
methods.description: Returns the initial resource bundle used for the wrapper.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the stack of resource bundles.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the layered resource bundles.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns the entry set of the layered resource bundles.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key, with optional string expansion if context is provided.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the stack is empty.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns the set of keys from the top-level map.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Puts a key-value pair into the top-level map.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Puts all entries from another map into the top-level map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the top-level map.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the top-level map.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns collection of values from the top-level map.
